preconditions.description: The input string A must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: The input string A must consist only of lower-case Latin letters.
The input string A must contain at most 30 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == max((A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)), key=lambda x: (A.count(x), -len(x), x))
postconditions.description: The output must be the non-empty substring of A that is repeated the most times, with the longest length in case of a tie, and the alphabetically latest substring in case of further ties.
